name: agent-mcp
description: MCP swiss-army bridge -- wrap an upstream MCP server (HTTP or stdio) as a local stdio MCP, inject host credentials, and apply a decorator stack (filter, rename/namespace, defer behind a tool-finder, code-mode run_code, storage stream-buffer, transform result-reshaping, gate preflight-conditional access). Dual-era: speaks both modern MCP 2.x (2026-07-28, stateless per-request metadata + server/discover) and the legacy initialize handshake, in both directions. Config-driven, one file per bridge.
